result_summary.title: Cohort Builder issues with compliance and retention
result_summary.description: The Cohort Builder in staging isn't working right. The compliance reports are missing data and the retention policy isn't applying correctly. It's affecting a lot of users. Please check why the reports are incomplete and why the retention rules aren't working. We need this fixed ASAP.

final_diagnosis.evidence_summary: The case is related to issues with the Cohort Builder in the staging environment, with compliance reports being incomplete and retention policies not being applied correctly. The evidence collected so far suggests a possible configuration issue or a data ingestion problem, but the confidence in these hypotheses is low. Human review is required to further analyze the issue and determine the root cause.
